name: Decor Image Autogen
description: Runs the image-generation CLI directly when the owner asks for decor ideas or images, and returns the real file. Removes the model's opportunity to fabricate an image path.

enabled.description: Master switch. Set false to fall back to normal model handling.

workspaceDir.description: Directory the CLI is run from. Defaults to the OpenClaw workspace.

script.description: Path to generate_cli.py, relative to workspaceDir.

model.description: Cirrascale image model id. Default stabilityai/sdxl-turbo.

timeoutMs.description: Max wall time for one generation. Default 120000.
